say:2:1430235101:1.text: More than that. This great lady grew up with High Priestess Velara. They were friends when they were young.
say:2:1430235101:1.source_cn: 不止是认识，这位大人可是和奎茵从小玩到大的玩伴。
say:2:1430235101:1.male: More than that. This great lady grew up with High Priestess Velara. They were friends when they were young.
say:2:1430235101:1.female: More than that. This great lady grew up with High Priestess Velara. They were friends when they were young.

say:3:1430235102:1.text: With your introduction, my son's wish to become a priest will come true.
say:3:1430235102:1.source_cn: 我相信有了大人的美言，我儿子成为祭司的愿望一定会实现。
say:3:1430235102:1.male: With your introduction, my son's wish to become a priest will come true.
say:3:1430235102:1.female: With your introduction, my son's wish to become a priest will come true.
